title: Ulyana and the Confession
author: Lior Thackeray
blurb: Ulyana Sterling, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
